items.title: 66086_Zilner T. Randolph oral history interview
items.q: I send for Bud, I didn't send for -- I mean, Louis didn't know it. Louis had me to get the band together.

ctx.x: Bud says he wrote some arrangements for that band, too. Do you recall that? Bud Johnson.

Well, I don't know. I don't recall anything of Bud's writing. I heard Bud say, when they were playing a tribute to Louis' death, I heard Bud say that Louis sent for he and his brother, but Louis didn't send for he and his brother. I sent for them. Louis didn't know anything about Bud, and I didn't know anything about Bud until -- the Oldham boys told me about Bud Johnson and them, and I send for Bud, I didn't send for -- I mean, Louis didn't know it. Louis had me to get the band together.
